verdict.rationale: The closest match is Document QnA, which combines OCR with an LLM so users can ask natural-language questions about documents, including multi-document queries and comparisons. However, it is documented as an API capability for building Q&A apps, not as an assistant built into the product that you hand tasks to. missing for 10: an in-product assistant UI, multi-step task delegation or agentic actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of an assistant experience.
